cases.summary: Total emf 6 V · source current 1 A · equivalent resistance 6 Ω.
The shell carries 20 nC; its distant transfer partner carries -20 nC. Wall attraction F_z = -0.000215701 N. Reversing charge reverses the polarization, while the attraction retains its direction.
Conductivity 58000000 S/m gives 0.058 A through the sample at 0.001 V. The same geometry and voltage can be compared across conductivities.
Separated charges ±1500 nC give 4235.28 V across 1 mm. The state is below the predicted self-sustaining-avalanche threshold.
Finite magnet centre z = -0.03 m at 0.35 s. Linked flux 0.000207589 Wb·turn; induced emf -0.00292014 V; pickup current -0.000292014 A.
At 0.5 s: linked flux 0.125664 Wb·turn; induced emf 0.394784 V; current 0.0388647 A.
At 1 s, centre z = 0.0302244 m and velocity = -0.0500303 m/s. The full cylinder leaves the lower end at 4.57333 s, retaining its exit velocity. Low-speed parameter μ₀σ|v|R_inner ≤ 0.143829.
The selected wire segment experiences equal and opposite magnetic forces: 0.0001 N on the left wire and -0.0001 N on the right. Parallel currents attract.
AC steady state: secondary voltage 20.6549 V; load power 4.26624 W. Ideal turns-ratio comparison N₂/N₁ = 2.
